cases.title: Java 2026-07-28 core is served by A1 and A5
cases.when: 2026-07-28 requests, MRTR scenarios and subscriptions/listen reach the Java runtime

cases.title: Tasks are served by A2 in every language
cases.when: The 10 tasks-* scenarios and ToolGate Tasks cases run
then: All pass; tasks/get without the extension gives -32021, never -32601

cases.title: Task status push is served by A2
cases.when: A listening client watches a task change state
then: notifications/tasks arrives; a ToolGate case covers what the suite skips

cases.title: .NET serves both versions on one URL
cases.when: A 2025 and a 2026 client use the same .NET endpoint
then: Both work; Stateful mode is never configured

cases.title: .NET custom methods return resultType
cases.when: A5-routed methods respond
then: resultType is present; no MCPEXP002 API is used

cases.title: Schemas are served exactly as in the descriptor
cases.when: A tool uses composition, conditional and anchor keywords
then: inputSchema is byte-identical to the descriptor in every language

cases.title: Bearer verification is done by A4, not the SDK
cases.when: Requests carry each A4 fixture token
then: Results match the A4 table; no SDK bearer support is used

cases.title: stdio era pinning follows the TS and Python rule
cases.when: initialize follows 2026 traffic on one stdio connection
then: -32022 in every language, including .NET

cases.title: .NET toolsListChanged is covered by a ToolGate case
cases.when: The catalog changes while a .NET client listens
then: toolsListChanged is delivered

cases.title: A4 identity fixtures
cases.when: Tokens: good, expired, not yet valid, wrong issuer, wrong audience, alg none, HS256 signed with the public key, unknown kid then known after refresh, revoked by introspection
then: Only good and the refreshed kid succeed
JWKS refresh at most once per 30 s
Introspection cache bounded by exp and 5 min

cases.title: A3 requestState cases
cases.when: Standalone requestState is tampered, expired, used by another identity, with other arguments, and replayed
then: All refused; a fresh one succeeds once

cases.title: Routing cases pass with and without the hook
cases.when: The A5 cases run with the routing hook and without it
then: Both pass

cases.title: No experimental or patched SDK API is used
cases.when: The SDK sources are scanned for experimental attributes and patched or forked SDK code
then: None found

cases.title: Every relied-on feature is PASS or adapter-owned
cases.when: The feature table is checked for the release
then: No SUPPORTED-BY-SOURCE or UNKNOWN feature is relied on

cases.title: Pin changes add a new record
cases.when: A pin changes
then: A new dated record directory is added; earlier records are unchanged
